about: List-editing fixtures shared by the Swift (SeanboyCore) and Kotlin (:core) ListEditing ports. `|` marks the caret; `«` and `»` mark a selection. `after: null` means the rule doesn't apply and the key does its normal thing. Actions: enter, tab, shiftTab, backspace, home, toggle.

cases.name: enter continues a bullet
enter keeps the bullet character and indent
enter splits an item at the caret
enter increments numbers
enter keeps the paren delimiter
enter after a done task starts an open task
enter on an empty item ends the list
enter on an empty task ends the list
enter on an empty nested item outdents it
enter inside the marker is a plain newline
enter outside a list is a plain newline
enter in a code block is a plain newline
tab indents with the note's tab style
tab indents with the note's space style
tab indents every selected item
tab outside a list inserts a tab
shift-tab outdents
shift-tab outdents one space level
shift-tab at the top level does nothing
backspace after the marker removes it
backspace after a task marker removes it
backspace after a nested marker outdents
backspace inside the text is normal
backspace with a selection is normal
home goes to the start of the item text
home from the text start goes to the line start
home outside a list is normal
toggle checks a task
toggle unchecks a task
toggle ignores plain bullets
